name: Thai Basil Tofu
ingredients: 1 cup green beans, cut in 3 cm pieces
4 garlic cloves and 2 red chillies, pounded or minced
1 cup Thai holy basil or sweet basil leaves
steps: Sear the tofu in a non-stick pan with half the oil for 6 minutes until golden; set aside.
Heat the remaining oil on high and stir-fry the garlic and chillies for 20 seconds.
Add the beans and pepper and stir-fry for 3 minutes.
Return the tofu, add the soy sauce and 2 tbsp water, and toss for 2 minutes.
Off the heat, fold in the basil and lime juice.
note: Fast and fiery; serve with a small portion of brown rice or on its own.
